description: Source code implementing X11 extension interactions for NVIDIA's NV-CONTROL extension, including extension querying, attribute management, event handling, and color conversion functions.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryExtension
methods.description: Checks if the NV-CONTROL extension is available on the display.

methods.description: Queries the version of the NV-CONTROL extension.

methods.description: Retrieves the count of available targets of a specified type.
